description: Synthetic AMA reference-retrieval benchmark, authored locally; not MTEB or a representative production dataset. Expected labels fixed before inference.

documents.text: Jira sprint board: engineering sprint tasks, issue status and assignees are tracked at https://example.invalid/jira.
Workday leave portal: submit vacation, paid time off and sick leave requests; manager approval is required.
Kafka consumer retry policy: transient failures use exponential backoff with jitter; exhausted messages go to the dead-letter queue.
Kafka offset guide: commit offsets only after processing; replay a topic by resetting consumer group offsets.
PostgreSQL backup runbook: nightly pg_dump backups; restore to a staging database and verify row counts.
PostgreSQL slow-query guide: use EXPLAIN ANALYZE, inspect query plans, and add appropriate indexes.
Redis cache incident guide: avoid cache stampedes with TTL jitter and single-flight locks; recover cache misses from the database.
Kubernetes deployment rollback: use kubectl rollout undo deployment and verify pod readiness and rollout status.
GitHub Actions release workflow: push a v-prefixed version tag to run checks, build the extension ZIP and attach it to a Release.
Node dependency installation: use pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in CI; commit pnpm-lock.yaml for reproducible dependencies.
AMA local Jina embedding setup: ONNX CPU endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1, model jina-v5-small, 1024 dimensions; click Test connection in Memory settings.
AMA chat LLM provider settings: configure OpenAI-compatible base URL, API key and chat model; Fetch lists available models.
AMA MCP configuration: add a Streamable HTTP tool-server URL and optional bearer token in Settings Tools; destructive tools need approval.
公司 VPN 连接说明：启动 VPN 客户端并完成双重认证，才能访问公司内网；连接失败先检查网络。
服务器 SSH 登录指南：使用 SSH 私钥和正确端口登录；禁止密码登录，不要分享私钥。
差旅报销入口：上传发票、填写费用类别和出差日期，提交财务审批；这不是请假系统。
团队周会安排：每周一上午十点进行项目进度同步，会前更新议程，会后记录行动项。
生产故障值班手册：通过 PagerDuty 联系当班工程师，按严重程度升级故障，并更新状态页。
Account recovery guide: use the self-service password reset page for a forgotten account password; never send passwords in chat.
AMA screenshot help: full-page capture scrolls and stitches the page, restores scroll position, and limits output to 1280 by 8000 pixels.
AMA saved memory management: open Manage memories to edit, disable, delete, or undo replacement of saved preferences and references.
AMA conversation history: search previous chats by keyword or semantics, reopen sessions, or delete old conversations.
Python isolated environment guide: create a virtual environment with python3.12 -m venv .venv and install packages inside it, not system Python.
Jina v5 model license: CC BY-NC 4.0 permits noncommercial use with attribution; commercial use requires appropriate permission.
